description: This file defines an abstract base class for unit tests in a Blazor application using bUnit. The class manages the lifecycle of a TestContext, creating it on instantiation and disposing of it properly to facilitate testing components.

classes.name: BaseTest
classes.description: An abstract class serving as a base for bUnit-based test classes, providing setup and teardown for a shared TestContext.

methods.name: BaseTest
methods.description: Constructor that creates a new TestContext instance.

methods.name: Dispose
methods.description: Implements IDisposable to dispose of the TestContext and suppress finalization.
